name: What should I prepare before contractors arrive for bathroom tile installation?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before contractors arrive for bathroom tile installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your installation begins, decide on your tile layout, grout color, and trim preferences, such as bullnose edges or metal profiles. Remove personal toiletries, shower curtains, rugs, and decorative items to give the crew clear access to the workspace. You should also verify whether your tile order includes an extra 10 to 15 percent overage to account for cuts, waste, and future repairs. In addition, discuss with the contractor how plumbing shutoffs will be handled if fixtures need to be disconnected during demolition.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear out personal items, finalize your tile and grout selections, confirm a 10 to 15 percent tile overage for cuts, and ensure clear access to plumbing shutoff valves.
